official.deadline_note: University scholarship funds, Kranken- und Unfallfonds, Legat Grobe and Lichtenstein Foundation: applications for the fall semester until June 15, applications for the spring semester until January 15.
official.application_cycle: Semester-based (fall semester: until June 15; spring semester: until January 15)
official.status_note: Applications for the university scholarship funds are accepted twice a year: until June 15 for the fall semester and until January 15 for the spring semester.
benefits: Supplementary university scholarships of CHF 200 to 600 per person, per month, primarily during the final degree phase (BA/MA)
Solidarity fund (Solifonds) of CHF 500 to 1000 per person, per semester
Legat Grobe of CHF 200 to 600 per person, per month for students completing biology degrees with a focal area in zoology/botany
Margarete and Walter Lichtenstein Foundation funds for medical students with Swiss citizenship
Exchange scholarships for students in exchange programmes
Advice from the Social Services student welfare office
eligibility: Enrolled at the University of Basel for the university scholarship funds and supplementary scholarships
University scholarship funds are awarded primarily in the final degree phase (BA/MA)
Legat Grobe: completing a degree in biology degree programmes with a focal area in zoology/botany
Lichtenstein Foundation funds: medical students with Swiss citizenship
Enrolled in an exchange programme for the exchange scholarships
requirements: Application by the relevant semester deadline (June 15 for the fall semester, January 15 for the spring semester)
coverage: Supplementary scholarships granted by the scholarship committee of the Senate, in addition to cantonal education contributions
University scholarship funds: CHF 200 to 600 per person, per month, primarily in the final degree phase
Solidarity fund (Solifonds): CHF 500 to 1000 per person, per semester
application_method: The student welfare office (Social Services) provides additional information and assists with the submission of applications
official.application_route: Apply through the university's Social Services student welfare office by the June 15 (fall) or January 15 (spring) deadline
official.citizenship_residency: No general nationality condition is stated for the supplementary scholarships; Lichtenstein Foundation funds require Swiss citizenship; international students are directed to scholarships in their home country
official.international_eligibility: Limited - the page directs international students to scholarships available in their home country; individual funds carry their own citizenship rules
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Legat Grobe is restricted to biology programmes with a zoology/botany focus; Lichtenstein funds to medical students
official.duration: Per academic year of enrolment; no fixed award term is published
official.description: The University of Basel grants supplementary scholarships through the Senate's scholarship committee in addition to cantonal education contributions - mainly CHF 200 to 600 per month in the final degree phase - alongside a student solidarity fund, subject-specific legacies and exchange scholarships, while the page stresses that primary funding responsibility lies with parents and the cantonal scholarship offices.
official.program_type: Umbrella funding hub: supplementary university scholarships plus signposting to cantonal and national scholarship schemes

not_confirmed: tuition_coverage - the funds are supplementary support, not tuition waivers
living_cost_coverage - the funds are not explicitly characterised as living-cost support
documents - no document list is published
verification.notes: This record is a funding information hub, not a single named scholarship. The amounts (CHF 200-600 per month; Solifonds CHF 500-1000 per semester) come from the official 'Funding from the University of Basel' page, and the June 15 / January 15 semester deadlines from the official Submission Deadlines page. Cantonal education contributions are handled by the cantonal offices for Basel-Stadt and Basel-Landschaft, not the university.

applicant_utility.summary: Basel's university scholarships are supplementary, not primary: cantonal education contributions are the main route, and the Senate committee adds smaller top-ups of CHF 200-600 per month mainly in your final BA/MA phase. Apply twice a year - by 15 June for the fall semester and 15 January for the spring - through the university's Social Services office, and heed the page's warning that international students should check home-country funding first.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Enrolled Basel students in the final phase of a BA/MA who need a top-up on cantonal support, including biology students (Legat Grobe) and Swiss medical students (Lichtenstein Foundation).
application_readiness_checklist: Secure your cantonal education contribution from your canton of residence first - university funds are explicitly supplementary
Apply by 15 June (fall) or 15 January (spring) via the Social Services student welfare office
Check the legacy funds' subject rules if you study biology (zoology/botany focus) or medicine
If you are an international student, investigate home-country scholarships in parallel
common_rejection_risks: Applying without first claiming cantonal support, which the page treats as the primary funding
Missing the semester cutoffs (15 June / 15 January)
Assuming the Solifonds (CHF 500-1,000 per semester) and the scholarship funds share one application
Overlooking that Lichtenstein Foundation funds require Swiss citizenship
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The bulk of Basel living costs and rent; university funds add at most CHF 600 per month and only in the final degree phase.
document_audit: The pages publish no document list - contact Social Services early because the office assists with the submission itself
Cantonal offices require their own forms plus family income and tax evidence
alerts: Lichtenstein Foundation funds are restricted to medical students with Swiss citizenship
Deadlines are semester-based, not annual - a missed 15 January means waiting until 15 June
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Cantonal contribution in place -> apply to Social Services by the semester cutoff -> Senate scholarship committee decides.
